full_judgment: 27. On critical analysis of the evidence it further appears that in this case it is established beyond all shadow of doubt from the evidence of the prosecution witnesses that on the date of occurrence i.e. on 08.12.2003 the victim girl Rina Akter @ Natun was residing in the residence of her husband which is situated in village-Machaile under Keraniganj police station. The witnesses who appeared after getting information of death, in a voice corroborated one-another to the effect that the dead body of the victim girl Natun was lying in the Varanda of the dwelling but of her husband Alamgir Hossain and at that time her husband Alamgir with other inmates of the house were absconding. Despite; here in this case, there is no eye-witness of the occurrence even then it is the husband who is exclusively liable to answer as to how and why his wife met with her death. Law enjoins that in a wife killing case it is quite natural that them could be no eye-witness of the occurrence, apart from inmates of the house who may refuse to tell the truth. The neighbors may not also come forward to depose about the prosecution case; and that is why there is a necessity to rely on the circumstantial evidence. When it is proved that the wife died in the house of her husband, in that case (as the instant case be); there would be strong presumption against the husband that in his hands the wife died. It is a decided matter that, if it is established that the wife who succumbed to death in the residence of her husband the husband is to explain as to how and why his wife met with her death. Their lordships in the case of Bias Hussain vs. State, 54 DLR(AD)78 held, when a wife met with an unnatural death in custody of the husband and also in his house the husband is to explain under what circumstance the wife met with her death.
